meta.pct_rule: percent reported only when base n >= 30, else 'base too small'
meta.sandbox_note: raw data outside the repo; authors replaced by salted hash; salt not committed
meta.crawl_scope_note: time-boxed crawl: 14 of 30 thread-discovery tasks, 6 of 120 keyword tasks and no wider-brand keyword tasks completed; see data/README.md
meta.comparison_basis: all cross-brand modules use general subreddits only

formulas.net_sentiment: (pos - neg) / (pos + neg + neu), VADER compound: pos >= 0.05, neg <= -0.05, else neu
formulas.top_of_mind_first: k = top-level replies whose first-named brand (earliest text position) is b; base = replies naming any brand; one reply per author per thread
formulas.top_of_mind_total: k = replies naming b at least once; base = replies naming any brand (multiple response, shares sum >100%)
formulas.penetration_proxy: k = distinct authors with >= 1 ownership/purchase phrase in a sentence naming b; base = distinct authors with >= 1 brand mention
formulas.correspondence_analysis: P=N/n; r,c = margins; S=(P-rc^T)/sqrt(rc^T); S=U*D*V^T; row coords=U*D/sqrt(r); col coords=V*D/sqrt(c); axis inertia=D^2; total inertia=chi2/n
formulas.adjusted_std_residual: (O-E)/sqrt(E*(1-row/n)*(1-col/n)); flagged |z|>1.96 and, stricter, |z|> Bonferroni z for alpha=.05/cells
formulas.kmeans: repertoire vector = share of author's brand-mention sentences per brand (+ 'other') and share touching each attribute; KMeans n_init=10 seed 0; k in 2..6 by silhouette

attributes.quality/durability: quality|durab|well[- ]made|falls? apart|fell apart|pill(s|ed|ing)\b|shrunk|shrinks?\b|seams?\b|stitch|fabric|material|flimsy|cheaply made|holds? up|wear and tear|lasted|last(s)? (long|years|forever)|\bthin\b|see[- ]through

sample.comparison_basis: general subreddits only; per-brand counts below are general-sub counts

top_of_mind.question: Which brands come to mind first when shoppers are asked where to shop / what to buy? (unaided awareness proxy)
top_of_mind.caveat: replies to recommendation threads in general fashion subs; recommenders answer for the asker, so this is a proxy for salience, not self-reported unaided awareness
top_of_mind.sample_composition_warning: thread selection is by reply count; the most-replied recommendation threads are mostly menswear (malefashionadvice), so brand shares lean to menswear-friendly brands (Uniqlo, Old Navy, Abercrombie, Lululemon) and cannot be read as the Gen Z / Millennial women's market

penetration_proxy.question: What share of brand-mentioning authors say they own or bought each brand?
penetration_proxy.disclosure: A proxy, NOT true penetration: only authors who talked about a brand are in the base, brand subreddits over-represent their own brand, and phrase matching misses and over-catches.

profiling.question: Who is talking: self-reported age, gender, country, and how does the brand mix differ by generation?
profiling.definitions: Gen Z = age 14-29, Millennial = 30-45 (in 2026), Older = 46+; first self-report by an author wins; age from '(24F)', 'I'm 24', '24 y/o', 'born in 1998'

positioning.question: How do brands differ on what people talk about (price, quality, fit, ...)?
positioning.unit: single-brand sentences containing an attribute keyword (a sentence can hit several attributes)

chi_square.note: hits are not fully independent (one author can contribute many); treat p as indicative

perception.question: How positive or negative is talk about each brand, and on which attributes?
perception.method: VADER (Hutto & Gilbert 2014) compound score on each single-brand sentence; thresholds +/-0.05

appstore.store_level_note: all-time store aggregates as of apps_lookup_utc; not the review sample
appstore.review_text_status: UNAVAILABLE: customer-review RSS returned empty feeds for all apps/storefronts at collection time (retried over ~2 hours)
appstore.note: app reviews judge the app/delivery as much as clothes; only the most recent reviews (RSS, max 10 pages x 50) are available; non-English text scores neutral

vader_validation.labeller: one human-equivalent labeller (the engineer agent), blind to VADER output; single rater, so no inter-rater reliability
vader_validation.caution: n=50 gives a wide interval; sentence sentiment toward a brand is not the same as VADER's sentence polarity

segmentation.question: Are there groups of shoppers with different brand repertoires and concerns?

segments.name: Zara-led, fit/sizing-minded (rule: highest brand lift with >=10% share; highest attribute lift)
Aritzia-led, shipping/returns-minded (rule: highest brand lift with >=10% share; highest attribute lift)
Shein-led, sustainability/ethics-minded (rule: highest brand lift with >=10% share; highest attribute lift)
Uniqlo-led, style/trend-minded (rule: highest brand lift with >=10% share; highest attribute lift)
H&M-led, quality/durability-minded (rule: highest brand lift with >=10% share; highest attribute lift)

segmentation.caveat: silhouette is often low on sparse share vectors; segments describe talk patterns, not validated shopper types

trend.question: Does public search interest (Wikipedia pageviews) track social mention volume?
trend.caveat: mention volume is bounded by collection caps per month/subreddit; use share-of-voice, not raw growth. Pageviews are English Wikipedia, all-access, user agent.

within_brand_context_brand_subreddits.label: WITHIN-BRAND CONTEXT ONLY: brand-subreddit sentences. Fan communities, not comparable across brands, never used to fill a general-sub cell.

supplementary.note: Supplementary analysis added after the audited report; every other top-level key is unchanged. Proxies from public social text, not survey measures.

funnel.label: SOCIAL-LISTENING PROXY, not a survey funnel: stages come from phrases in public posts, and only authors who talked about the brand are in the base
funnel.base: distinct authors mentioning the brand in general subreddits (= sample.authors_per_brand)

stages.considering: intent phrase in a sentence naming the brand, or any later stage
stages.advocate: owner who also used a recommend/repeat phrase about the brand

funnel.advocate_regex: highly recommend|would recommend|buy(?:ing)? again|bought again|always buy|keep buying|repurchase|go-to|obsessed with my
funnel.formulas: share_of_aware = stage k / aware k; conversion = stage k / previous stage k; Wilson 95% CI; shown only when the base n >= 30; multi-brand sentences credit every brand named

positioning_map.rule: brands with >= 30 attribute hits (same as the positioning matrix); x = price/value share of the brand's attribute hits, y = style/trend share, bubble = mention sentences, colour = net sentiment (VADER)

cheap/disposable.regex: \bcheap(ly)?\b|cheaply made|disposable|throwaway|one[- ]wear|ultra[- ]fast fashion|falls? apart|fell apart|flimsy|\bjunk\b|\btrash\b|low quality|poorly made|landfill

reliable/consistent.regex: reliab|\bconsistent(ly)?\b|dependable|never (disappoints?|fails?|let me down)|trustworthy|holds? up|true to size|\btts\b|every time

inconsistent/hit-or-miss.regex: inconsistent|hit[- ]or[- ]miss|hit and miss|unreliable|quality (has )?(dropped|declined|gone down)|gone downhill|\bvaries\b|\bvary\b|lottery|gamble|not what it used to be

brand_image.unit: single-brand sentences with at least one image keyword (a sentence can carry several images); multi-brand sentences excluded

chi_square_independence.note: one author can contribute many sentences, so p is indicative

strengths_and_weaknesses_bonferroni.rule: |adjusted standardised residual| above the Bonferroni z over all cells; over-index on a favourable image or under-index on an unfavourable one = strength, the reverse = weakness; neutral images = distinctive

cells.caution: keyword association is not endorsement: people also discuss a brand's (un)ethical or cheap image critically; read with the cell sentiment

priority_quadrant.rule: only brand x image cells with n >= 30; strong = brand's share of the image >= pooled set-average share (index >= 1.0), weak otherwise; positive = net sentiment within the cell > 0. strong+positive = defend, strong+negative = fix, weak+positive = hidden asset, weak+negative = low priority
